content: Shaurya Joshi followed up with insurance agent Neha Kapoor regarding the upgrade options for his expired health policy, expressing uncertainty about the added dental and vision benefits. Neha responded by detailing the coverage for dental (routine check-ups, fillings, extractions) and vision (exams, glasses, contact lenses), noting a 6-month waiting period for major dental procedures, and provided a detailed brochure for review.

action_items: Review the attached Dental and Vision brochure
Determine whether to proceed with the policy upgrade
